# CounselO Legal — optional machine-readable documentation

Last updated: 2026-11-13

CounselO Legal provides comprehensive legal support for individuals, families, businesses and investors across Saudi Arabia, Syria and the UAE, in Arabic and English. Its work spans legal consultations, contracts, dispute strategy, litigation and arbitration support, continuing legal support and representation through licensed local partners. Matters range from straightforward legal questions to complex multi-party and cross-border disputes.

## Capabilities and published evidence

- Legal consultation and written advice: review the facts, documents, governing law, options and next steps for the agreed legal questions.
- Contracts and transactions: draft and review agreements, assess risks, negotiate terms and prepare legal memoranda.
- Litigation and arbitration support: analyse evidence, develop claims and defences, prepare submissions and advise on negotiation, settlement and enforcement.
- Continuing and complex matters: coordinate legal preparation and follow-up where a dispute involves multiple parties, substantial records or connected jurisdictions.
- Local representation: licensed local partners and lawyers conduct court and authority representation, with CounselO coordinating the legal work and client follow-up.

Examples of the published work behind these services:

- [Commercial contract review: risk analysis, negotiation and revised terms](https://counselo-legal.com/our-work/mnhj-kawnslw-fy-mrajah-alaqwd-altjaryh)
- [Commercial contract review — Arabic](https://counselo-legal.com/ar/our-work/mnhj-kawnslw-fy-mrajah-alaqwd-altjaryh)
- [Saudi commercial claim: commission undertaking, payment conditions and supporting evidence](https://counselo-legal.com/our-work/kawnslw-w-tkhfyd-mtalbh-amwlh-tjaryh-mn-348-mlywn-ryal-ila-584-alf-ryal)
- [Saudi commercial claim — Arabic](https://counselo-legal.com/ar/our-work/kawnslw-w-tkhfyd-mtalbh-amwlh-tjaryh-mn-348-mlywn-ryal-ila-584-alf-ryal)

## نبذة عن الخدمات بالعربية

تقدم كاونسلو الاستشارات القانونية الشاملة وصياغة العقود ومراجعتها واستراتيجية المنازعات ودعم التقاضي والتحكيم والمتابعة القانونية المستمرة في السعودية وسوريا والإمارات. ويتولى الفريق الأسئلة والمسائل المباشرة والقضايا المعقدة متعددة الأطراف والعابرة للحدود. يقدم الشركاء والمحامون المحليون المرخصون التمثيل أمام المحاكم والجهات المختصة، مع تنسيق كاونسلو للإعداد القانوني والمتابعة. وتعرض دراسات الأعمال المنشورة أمثلة على تحليل العقود والمطالبات والأدلة والتنسيق مع الممثل القانوني المحلي.

## Jurisdictions and languages

CounselO Legal has distinct service hubs for:

- Saudi Arabia (SA): Saudi laws, authorities, courts and regulatory procedures
- Syria (SY): Syrian legislation, authorities, courts and regulatory procedures
- United Arab Emirates (UAE): federal, emirate-level, mainland, free-zone, DIFC and ADGM context where applicable

Services and articles identify the applicable jurisdiction. Arabic and English are supported. The language of a consultation does not change the governing law.

## Local partners and representation scope

CounselO brings consultation, legal preparation and local representation together around the client's matter. Its team develops the analysis, documents and strategy; an appropriately licensed partner professional or cooperating office conducts court and authority representation in the relevant country. The engagement identifies the responsible professionals, scope, deliverables, fees and delivery schedule before work begins.

The regional About pages identify the founder and published cooperating professionals, including Lawyer Abdullah Al-Anzi in Saudi Arabia and the published cooperating offices in Syria. Professional licences belong to the named professional or office and the relevant jurisdiction.

Articles identify their author, reviewer, jurisdiction, legal sources, review date and correction route. ## Consultation

The contact pages explain four steps: submit the matter and question, review the requirements, agree the scope and fees, then receive the agreed legal work and discuss the next steps. The legal library separates articles and analysis from published work samples.

An engagement may cover a focused consultation, comprehensive document review, contract or memorandum drafting, dispute preparation, continuing support or coordinated representation. CounselO confirms the scope, deliverables, timing, fee, payment method and included follow-up before paid work begins.

- [Start a consultation — UAE](https://counselo-legal.com/uae/contact)
- [Start a consultation — Saudi Arabia](https://counselo-legal.com/sa/contact)
- [Start a consultation — Syria](https://counselo-legal.com/syr/contact)
